message.content:
Based on the screenshots provided, here are the answers to your questions:

**1) Image 1 (Landing Page):**
*   **Avatar:** Yes, the avatar is a freeform transparent cutout of a person. It has no circular or square container and no visible drop shadow.
*   **Designation/Title:** The text is **"Software Developer"**.

**2) Image 2 (About-Me Card):**
*   **Layout:**
    *   **Beside the photo:** To the right of the photo is a status line ("when a product demands it.") followed by a row of **tags**: AI, Developer, SaaS Builder, Node.js, and Next.js.
    *   **Under it:** Below the photo and tags is a paragraph of descriptive text, followed by a large blue heading ("I don't just write code, I build systems."), then a 2x2 grid of info cards (Based in, Studied at, Focus, Open to), a conversational text bubble, and finally the navigation/search bar.
*   **Tags:** Yes, all the specified tags (**AI, Developer, SaaS Builder, Node.js, Next.js**) are clearly visible as pill-shaped buttons next to the photo.
*   **Layout Issues:** There are **no layout issues**. There is no overlapping text, no cut-off content, and the spacing appears clean and intentional throughout the card.
